title: About
subtitle: Why the portal exists and what it offers.
mission: Make it easy for trainees to take part in college life: know about events in time, volunteer with transparently tracked hours, and reach college services without paperwork or office visits.

offer.events: An up-to-date event calendar with times, venues and available seats.
offer.volunteering: Volunteering in event management, design, translation and tech support, with certified hours.
offer.facilities: Booking requests for the theater, events hall, stadium and gymnasium, with approval tracking.
offer.feedback: Suggestions and complaints with status tracking and administration replies.

history: The portal evolves the college's previous internal volunteering system: it keeps its services and adds events, hour tracking and full Arabic/English support.
